display.name: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL - Engine Metrics
display.description: PostgreSQL engine internals for Amazon Aurora, from the OpenTelemetry postgresql receiver: connections, transactions, row and block activity, background writer and checkpoints, table and index usage. Aurora replicates through its shared storage volume rather than streaming replication, so pg_stat_replication is empty and the receiver's replication metrics never populate; use Aurora Replica Lag on the CloudWatch overview instead.

display.name: instance
display.description: PostgreSQL endpoint each receiver scrapes. Run one receiver per instance endpoint so the writer and each reader stay separate.

display.name: db_name
display.description: Databases reported by the postgresql receiver.

display.name: table_name
display.description: Filter the table-level panels (`postgresql.table.name`). Values are schema-qualified, for example `public.orders`. Index panels are scoped by database instead, because the receiver reports unqualified table names on index metrics.

display.name: Backends by Database
display.description: Backend processes per database. Counts autovacuum and parallel workers alongside client sessions.

display.name: Maximum Connections
display.description: Configured max_connections. On Aurora Serverless v2 this moves with the ACU range.

display.name: Database Count
display.description: User databases on the instance.

display.name: Database Size
display.description: Disk used per database.

display.name: Commits
display.description: Transactions committed per interval, per database.

display.name: Rollbacks
display.description: Transactions rolled back per interval. A rising share against commits points at application errors or lock timeouts.

display.name: Deadlocks
display.description: Deadlocks detected per interval, per database.

display.name: Locks by Mode
display.description: Locks held, grouped by lock mode. AccessExclusiveLock appearing under load means DDL is blocking queries.

display.name: Row Operations
display.description: Rows inserted, updated, deleted and HOT-updated per interval. A low hot_upd share against upd means index maintenance is doing extra work.

filter.expression: postgresql.database.name IN $db_name AND postgresql.table.name IN $table_name AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Live and Dead Rows
display.description: Live and dead tuples per table. Dead rows piling up is the first sign autovacuum is not keeping up.

filter.expression: postgresql.database.name IN $db_name AND postgresql.table.name IN $table_name AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Blocks Read by Source
display.description: Block reads per interval by source. The *_read counters are misses served from storage; *_hit are served from the buffer cache.

filter.expression: postgresql.database.name IN $db_name AND postgresql.table.name IN $table_name AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Buffers Written by Source
display.description: Buffers written per interval by the background writer, checkpointer and backends. A high backend share means the background writer is not keeping ahead of the workload.

display.name: Buffers Allocated
display.description: Buffers allocated per interval.

display.name: Checkpoints by Type
display.description: Checkpoints per interval. Requested checkpoints outnumbering scheduled ones means WAL is filling faster than the checkpoint interval.

display.name: Checkpoint Duration by Type
display.description: Time spent writing and syncing checkpoint files per interval.

display.name: Background Writer Stops
display.description: Times the background writer stopped a cleaning scan for writing too many buffers. Persistent counts argue for a larger bgwriter_lru_maxpages.

display.name: Table Count
display.description: User tables per database.

display.name: Vacuum Runs
display.description: Manual vacuum runs per interval, per table.

filter.expression: postgresql.database.name IN $db_name AND postgresql.table.name IN $table_name AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Index Scans
display.description: Index scans per interval. Indexes flat at zero over a long window are candidates for removal. Scoped by database only: the receiver reports unqualified table names on index metrics, so the table selector does not apply here.

display.name: Table Size
display.description: Disk used per table.

filter.expression: postgresql.database.name IN $db_name AND postgresql.table.name IN $table_name AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Index Size
display.description: Disk used per index. Scoped by database only: the receiver reports unqualified table names on index metrics, so the table selector does not apply here.
